theorems.name: Submission.p02_es_177ebb5a_tb_periodic_strip_bound
theorems.statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (q : UpperHalfPlane → ℂ), (∀ τ : UpperHalfPlane, q ((ModularGroup.T ^ N) • τ) = q τ) → (∃ M Y : ℝ, ∀ τ : UpperHalfPlane, 0 ≤ τ.re → τ.re ≤ (N : ℝ) → Y ≤ τ.im → ‖q τ‖ ≤ M) → UpperHalfPlane.IsBoundedAtImInfty q
theorems.natural_summary: For any τ above height Y, let m = floor(τ.re/N). Integer periodicity preserves q under translation by −mN. This translation preserves imaginary height and places the real part in [0,N), so the strip bound applies. The same M and Y then witness boundedness at imaginary infinity.
